card.name: The word every after a dose or count
card.fires_on: The word "every" (or sometimes "all") right after a quantity, dose or list of items, where it introduces a repeat interval or a group such as "every 3 weeks" or "all sixth-graders".

modes.description: "all" following a list of named people, before a shared description or action.

card.plain: It marks the word "every" or "all" that introduces how often something repeats or who a group covers.
